key_catalyst: Rising Treasury yields at multi-month highs ahead of FOMC meeting (July 28-29)
reasoning: QQQ has suffered two consecutive sharp down sessions (-1.37% and -1.38%) with multiple primary drivers still escalating. Treasury yields hit 4.703% — the highest since January 2025 — just days before the FOMC meeting on July 28-29, with rate-hike probability surging from 10% to 35%. Simultaneously, AI capex fears remain acute after Tesla and Alphabet's poor results, with semis dropping 4.5% and more Magnificent 7 earnings (Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, Apple) imminent next week. Both catalysts are escalating, not resolving.
